notes: This contract records only the private FDD metadata needed by Umbra's no-TSO time-bounds calculator, TAR grant-decision kernel, and limited TAR scheduler. The composed catalog retains the Non-Regulated-Grant setting, applies the IEEE 1516.2 default of Disabled when the setting is omitted, and keeps the existing setting when a later module supplies a non-equivalent duplicate switch; the latter produces a private Annex C.8 preflight warning. The opt-in scheduler captures the setting at federation creation and uses that static value for no-TSO TAR release; an additional-FOM join cannot change an active execution's NRG policy. The public getter is traced separately, and full time coordination and conformance remain open.
